headline: Venezuelan Opposition Leader María Corina Machado Returns from Exile
summary: Venezuelan opposition figure María Corina Machado returned to Venezuela after nearly a year in exile, addressing supporters in Barquisimeto.
why: Venezuela's political opposition dynamics heavily influence US sanctions policy on Venezuelan oil production and sovereign debt restructuring discussions.

impacts.name: Venezuela
impacts.why: High-profile opposition mobilization tests government tolerance and impacts international sanction negotiations.
